title: ‘She’s Never Going to Age’: Porn Stars Are Embracing AI Clones to Stay Forever Young | WIRED
summary: Lisa Ann, a former adult performer, has partnered with OhChat to create a digital twin of herself, allowing users to generate explicit content. The platform also hosts other creators and has competitors in the market.
